_about: Sign vocabulary used by the data-collection tool, the recogniser and the UI. 'word' signs go into the sentence, 'control' signs operate the app, 'none' is the background class. The key-poses are the handshapes of the Instant recogniser (gesturebridge/handshape_rules.py), so recordings and instant mode use the same signs. Replace them with real ISL handshapes if you like - the trained model only cares about the label.

signs.label: HELLO
signs.keypose: Open hand, all fingers straight, thumb sticking out.

signs.label: I
signs.keypose: Fist with only the little finger up, thumb tucked in.

signs.label: YOU
signs.keypose: Index finger pointing up, other fingers curled, thumb tucked in.

signs.label: WANT
signs.keypose: Thumb, index and middle finger out (like the number 3), ring and little finger curled.

signs.label: WATER
signs.keypose: Index, middle and ring fingers up (W), little finger curled.

signs.label: FOOD
signs.keypose: Flat-O: all fingertips pinched together against the thumb.

signs.label: HUNGRY
signs.keypose: C-shape: all fingers curved, thumb out, as if holding a cup.

signs.label: HELP
signs.keypose: Thumbs up.

signs.label: NO
signs.keypose: Thumbs down.

signs.label: YES
signs.keypose: Closed fist with the thumb tucked in.

signs.label: THANK_YOU
signs.keypose: I-love-you hand: thumb, index and little finger out.
signs.basis: End position of ASL THANK YOU

signs.label: PLEASE
signs.keypose: Flat hand, all four fingers straight, thumb tucked in.

signs.label: SORRY
signs.keypose: Y-hand: thumb and little finger out.

signs.label: GO
signs.keypose: Index finger pointing sideways, thumb tucked in.

signs.label: HOME
signs.keypose: L-shape: thumb and index finger out.

signs.label: THIRSTY
signs.keypose: Index finger pointing down, thumb tucked in.
signs.basis: ASL THIRSTY (index traces down the throat)

signs.label: MY
signs.keypose: Flat hand sideways (fingers pointing left/right), thumb tucked in.
signs.basis: ASL MY (flat hand on the chest)

signs.label: NAME
signs.keypose: Index and middle finger together, pointing sideways (H), thumb tucked.

signs.label: SPEAK
signs.keypose: OK sign: thumb and index fingertip touching, other three fingers up.
signs.action: Finish the sentence and speak it

signs.label: CLEAR
signs.keypose: V sign: index and middle finger up, thumb tucked in.

signs.label: DELETE
signs.keypose: Horns: index and little finger up, thumb tucked in.

signs.label: NOTHING
signs.keypose: Relaxed hand, hand moving between signs, scratching, resting - anything that is NOT a sign.
signs.action: Ignored (stops random movements from being read as signs)
